text: Concrete bounds asymmetry found in the 2026-08-03 quality review, verified against current source. The remote-path decoders bound base64 before allocating: decodeRemoteBoundedEvidence (AgentDomainJson.scala:1557) calls decodeBase64Bounded, which checks encoded length against a derived ceiling (:1224-1230) BEFORE Base64.getDecoder.decode, then re-checks the decoded size. Two agent-path decoders skip that entirely and decode straight into an unbounded array: Decoder[BoundedEvidence] (:1742) and Decoder[LogPage] via decodeBase64 (:2056, helper at :2112). Frame-level maximumFrameBytes is the only thing bounding them today, so this is defence-in-depth rather than a live overflow, but the check-before-allocate discipline is exactly what the bounds half of this acceptance criterion should make uniform. Also unbounded: the resultRefs collection is decoded with no cardinality cap (:598-603) while its elements are individually bounded.
